description: Fetches a site sitemap, stores its URL inventory as a durable baseline, and on later calls returns only added/removed URLs versus that baseline (submap crawling supported). Price: $0.01 per call in USDC on Base (eip155:8453), paid with x402 in params._meta["x402/payment"]. HTTP: GET https://api.firstmention.uk/s/chgwatch/sitemapdiff

url.description: Site base URL or sitemap URL
